steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (So... this is Lungmen.)

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (I must hurry—)

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Kind sir, would you spare me a moment?
Hmm?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: There is something I would like to ask.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Is Master Tung's finball stall nearby?
You... You are not from Lungmen, are you?
Came to sample his reputed finballs, have you?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Uh, yes, but of course! They're famous far and wide, hahaha—
Well, what time do you think it is? They closed for the day long ago.
If you truly want a bite, you'll want to line up at eight in the morning.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: It has closed? Do you perchance know where Master Tung lives, then?
Hm...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Kind sir?
You're here to sample his finballs. Why would his name or address matter to you at all?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Err... Hahaha, quite right. Haha... I'll wait till the morrow then—
Young man...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Mmh—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —K-Kind sir? What is the meaning of this? Please, lower your cane—
What do you want with Tung?
I suggest you behave yourself here, young man. Now, explain.
You covered practically the entire town within just one night, from the old folks to the Greytails' boss. Now, you even ask for a finball hawker.
No one would come to this place to seek him out at this hour. Moreover... I know what it is that you are holding.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —You... Are you...?! Mmph!
Don't move, young man. Answer me first. Who else do you seek?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Only those I've already asked about! I am looking for Uncle Tung only because I have no choice—!
Is your name Lien?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: No! No, it is not! Please, listen to me—
Stop.
I am not one to mistake a man trained in the martial arts for a hooligan... And you hold the Lien clan's Yin-ch'ing fan. How are you related to Lien Tzu-hsu?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —She's my master!
What became of her?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My master...
What became of her?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: She passed!
...How?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: She... She was damned well murdered... because of me, an imbecile of a disciple!
...A shame.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Master Lin—!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Hmph... You know my name. How?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I-I heard of you from my master... Please, I cannot be caught by those men yet!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You came here to Lungmen merely to drag out what time you have left.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: The flame can't be snuffed!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I suggest you go to the L.G.D.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: This is nothing the police can manage!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Very well... Out of respect for Tung's friendship with your old master, I give you this chance.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You have three moves. Break my cane, and you may come with me.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —N-No, I can't!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Do it.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My master told me. The debt that Uncle Tung owes Lin of Lungmen... is also hers. No matter the circumstances, I must not disrespect—

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Do it!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —I'm afraid I can't!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: You coward! Unfold your fan!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My name is not Lien! I am undeserving!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Yet you hold her fan!!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Lien is not my name!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Then your master died for nothing!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Hm, well executed...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Master Lin... please forgive me.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Stand up. I forced your hand. Nothing to kneel for.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Stay here in Lungmen for five years. After five years, I will send you back to Kou-wu City. What happens next, you'll have to figure out yourself.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Brother Nothing, are you really leaving?

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Stay in Lungmen. It's a nice place, no?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I have yet to do what I must.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Looks like we aren't keeping you here... Can we share one last drink, then?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Save it. If I make it back alive, we will share this drink.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: If that time comes, I suppose I won't be using this pseudonym anymore.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: —Great!

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: We await your return!

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: So you really came back. That I did not expect...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But I must return. I am indebted to you. I cannot well just pack up and leave.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: Hoh. Look how much of a smooth-talker you've become. I wish you'd seen how nervous you were when we first met.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ha. Haha, Master Lin. At least save me some face.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: What's your plan after this?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: It's all over, but I've made enemies everywhere. It's not realistic for me to stay in my hometown.

steps.name: Lin
steps.text: I've got a storefront downtown you can have. Not cheap, though.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Of course, I can't take what's yours without proper payment.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: So this is your training hall, Brother?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Indeed it is. I named it 'Friendship,' for friendship is wealth as the saying goes. What do you think?

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Sounds kinda like a fitness center for the elderly...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: As long as it earns me good coin, why does it matter in this day and age that it's a fitness center for the elderly?!

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Will anyone actually come...? Ugh, you charge the memberships by the year too?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Ahaha... It's not necessarily a bad thing to have no customers. I heard this is fashionable in recent...

steps.name: Lungmen Passerby
steps.text: Excuse me, is this a fitness center?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My oh my. Please come this way, esteemed guest. We are a traditional Yan martial arts training center. I guarantee you'll find yourself most hale and hearty in no time!

steps.name: Lungmen Passerby
steps.text: Oh, I see. Give me a minute. Let me find my card.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Brother Nothing!

steps.name: Lungmen Passerby
steps.text: Don't you think you're safe just because you're in Lungmen. You aren't getting away—

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Bastard, die!

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Brother Nothing, are you alright?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Open your eyes... Do I look alright...?

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Hang in there! I'll call an ambulance right away—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Save it... *cough* *cough*... It's too late; I can tell. It's opening day, and blood has already been spilled. Just my luck...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I... *cough*, stop crying. You are a big guy. It's nothing uncommon to see a fellow man die.

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: I... I'm not... I...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: It's okay... This... is how it's meant to be...

steps.name: Greytail
steps.text: Brother Nothing!!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, so you aren't doing anything the rest of your life but avenging your master. You even had to kill yourself in your dream. Really, man?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I... Did I just...?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Did you what? If I didn't come fetch you, you'd have started all over again from the moment you left Kou-wu.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Now get up and get to work!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Why am I...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Kroos! You're up!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Beagle?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Why are you still... wearing your Rhodes Island outfit...?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hehe, we may be on vacation, but I really like it.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: See? This part here is nice, right?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Is this your new place?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Mm-hm!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Why don't you stay here for a few more days? I'll take real good care of you!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Yeah!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Do we really need to go from here...?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Shh!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Look over there...

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: ...Tsk, what a pain in the ass. That caravan barely had anything to take. Drew this big of a crowd here too! If I knew it'd be this much trouble, I wouldn't have taken the job!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: No use complaining now though. Hey, get the goods moved over here. That's a pretty good spot! Be sure to mark it down!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —Bandits?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Yeah, a Messenger said it's not very safe out on the mountains... So this is where they've all been hiding.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Kroos, we need to hurry back to tell security—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —Why? We can take care of them.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Kroos, let's not get ahead of—

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Hey, there's another caravan! Might be a merchant!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We'll lose our chance if we don't hurry.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: I never expected you of all people to say that...

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Oh, looks like they're on the move! I'll protect—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —Huff!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: You—?!

steps.name: Bounty Hunter
steps.text: Ugh?! What's wrong? Why did he pass out?!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm here.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Whoa... you took care of them all so quick... Even avoided their vitals so that they're only incapacitated.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: When did you become such a badass?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Let's go get the guards.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Sure!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *Yawn*... Morning.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hey, Kroos, did you sleep well?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I had to go to bed early all of a sudden. How was I supposed to fall asleep fine?

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Haha, but you know how early the Messengers leave. If you want to hitch a ride, you gotta head there early.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Oh, don't be like that. We just won't get to see each other for a while. You can come visit me any time.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Oh, and be sure to tell Fang I said hello. I wonder how she's doing these days...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Hehe.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Okay, here's your luggage. I got it all packed up for you.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Alright, enough with the sad face. Smile! You'll get to see Fang real soon!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: Be sure to bring me some Columbian souvenirs!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Yeah!

steps.name: Beagle
steps.text: See you, Kroos!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We'll meet again, Beagle—
See you. We'll meet again.
You know that's not how things will end.
What you will face on the path ahead will be far worse.
I... knew you'd be here. Sorry, but I won't let you pass. No matter what.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What...? Did I just...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: ...Finally awake, huh?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: We've been stuck here for a long time... Looks like you had a pretty sweet dream, though.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Sorry.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: It's nothing to apologize for... but we're running out of rations, Kroos.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: We gotta give it a shot, head to the other side of the valley and see what's going on there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: It's been way too long since we heard anything from the Bolívarian army. Did they change their route or something?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Beagle...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: Anyway, we gotta leave. The mission was over a long time ago... We need to report back to Rhodes Island as well...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No, this isn't right.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: This isn't... This makes no sense...! The emergency comms aren't working!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: B-But their camp shouldn't be that far away, going by the operation's map!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hey—! Where are you guys?!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: T-This...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Beagle...? Are you sure it's her?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: N-No way! How come?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: ...We'll have a detailed report later on.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: And well... Kroos, we probably shouldn't get too involved in this mess... If Bolívar's really this complicated... there's nothing we can do for her.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard
steps.text: We need to head back to the Rhodes Island landship...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You want me to stand by and watch her—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —No, I... I... I should've stopped her! I should've stopped her, whatever it took...!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hey, Kroos.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Sorry, Nian, but I'm not in the mood to...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Okay. Huh. Turns out Dusk couldn't have given you guys a better life, even in your dreams.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: All she did was draw the rest of your lives out in the painting and let them play out again from the beginning. It's all fake anyway. Couldn't you have picked a better ending?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What are you talking about—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't worry, don't worry. Nian's here to save the day.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I'm her big sister, after all.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Kroos! Mr. Nothing!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: It's so dark here... What's going on...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I thought I saw the Umbrella-Boiler... put out the flames that he just lit up...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...What's going on...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hm, I wonder how things are going with Saga...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...There's ground beneath my feet, at least, but I gotta be careful...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Lava.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Waaahhh?!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: N-Nian?! What are you doing here?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, don't worry. I'm the real, 100% legit Nian you know and love, here to save you guys' asses.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's just, uh, how should I put this. She sure threw you for a loop...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I can't see anything—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —Hold up, I can kinda make something out... Is there someone over there?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's a trap.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: She noticed what that thing I gave you is for, so she put all of you in some far-fetched, otherworldly dream right away. Too bad... got here a bit too late.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How do you even do this?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: No idea. It's not that hard to carve a person's consciousness out of their minds. After all, the point wasn't to give you guys a second life. Fundamentally, it's more like... a kaleidoscope for you to reflect on and question yourself.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Whether it's a large mirror, a huge lake, or a vast sky full of stars, once you enter the painting, there is no way out. This is that almighty.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: I wonder why you alone are an exception, though. Oh, maybe it's cause we had all that hotpot together...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Don't drag me into a mess like this for a reason like that. Anyway, thanks.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Nian?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Hm? Oh, it's nothing.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Wanna hear another story? Unlike Dusk, I'm not some uptight shut-in who hates the outdoors. This one isn't going to be nearly as boring.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Given the circumstances, I think we should worry about how to get out—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Eh, you don't want to learn about how these people from the olden days fought off those Feranmuts when they were years behind with their industries, populations, and Originium Arts?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The last time you changed the conversation like that, we ended up with the Dark Devastator stuff.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Well, looks like you're interested.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I... Whatever, go ahead...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: A long time ago, there existed many gods in the lands of Yan.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: The Yan emperor at the time saw his territory prosper, but his people suffered disasters and misfortunes one after another. He lamented this vicious cycle, and spent a long time to come up with a solution.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: He was the True Lung. Likely one of the most controversial men in Yan history, he was at the time still young in years, and his passion was unrivaled. As the emperor of Yan, he turned to his trusted retinue and told them this—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: All the lands under heaven belong to the throne, and all men are my servants. Why then do the divinities above listen not to the will of the people of Great Yan and deprive our lands of their protection?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...As you probably know, when the 'gods' are brought up in certain countries' folklore or history, they aren't necessarily merely philosophical concepts. That said, they aren't exactly all that mighty and revered either.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Case in point, the Lung found one such god deep in the mountains. A prideful and disdainful god.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yan's long history was a brief stretch of time to him... Naturally, he didn't give any thought to the Lung's opinions, and he had no reason to care about the lives of mere mortals.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Now, this is where the problem lies. The Lung was too concerned with his subjects and his country.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: He issued and personally led his entire military, joined by many a formidable fighter, to take to the mountains on this wild hunt—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And... beyond anyone's expectations, being that the Lung first uncovered there decided to betray his kin and his fellow deities. It divided up its own strength, and participated in this once-in-a-lifetime wild hunt.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: After this great wild hunt, Yan slayed several of these 'gods' who dared to stand up against the Lung, and all those unwilling to submit to his rule were exiled.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Much blood was shed, and many lives were lost. Yan paid a dear price, and that's how this controversy surrounding the True Lung came to be.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But he personally didn't care about this, and his campaign continued for as long as the Lung lived.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: When he was finally old and frail, he found the last such being remaining in Yan's lands. The most ancient and the most sacred. The eternal being that chose to betray its kin for the Lung's cause.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: The traitor had already received the justice it deserved. When its kin left the lands of Yan, they also took care to put out its flames of arrogance. Thus, its true nature was laid bare to the emperor—

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Anyway, its contributions had more than earned it the Lung's mercy. Nonetheless, the Lung forced it to serve Yan. To serve heaven, the lands, and its people to keep the world at peace.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Ever since, the fortunes of Yan have always belonged to the True Lung and his subjects.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: And at the same time, the so-called 'gods'—Though they had existed long before all the nations in the world came to be, they chose to hide themselves. They spread their own seeds across the land, placed the broken shards of their power and souls, and let them take root in this world in their place.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: They still exist in all shapes and forms across Terra, though their numbers are nowhere as great as before.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: But they all learned their lesson. Now, they're living across the world with everyone like one big family. Yep, it's a pretty good ending, don't you think?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: ...Many nations have risen in Terra, and each one went through major changes throughout history. Yet, beyond Yan, there isn't a dynasty, a human who can tell this tale of the ennobling of the gods.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Yan is a real scary place.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Eh, anyway, let's blow this joint. I don't wanna stay here any longer.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: This painting is Dusk's trump card. We've got her indecisiveness to thank though. We wouldn't have a way out otherwise.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: ...H-How are you going to do that...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What... What happened to us...?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Mnn, my brain hurts... Hmm? My benefactor, Kroos?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Nothing...? Where's Lava? Where's Saga?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: No idea, they... M-My benefactor, are we back in Mount Hui-ch'i?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...Leave.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Who are you...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'll say this only once.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Don't tell me... You are Dusk?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: This was Nian's idea, wasn't it?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I don't know who you people are, and I don't want to know what you've got to do with her. I don't care.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Now leave.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Don't tell me... You are the villain behind it all...?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What if I am?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: For someone who dared to disrupt my tranquility over and over, this is no punishment at all.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You don't mean, it's all because of the firecrackers...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You've got it all wrong. We weren't trying to—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Wrong?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Nian may be able to fool you, but she can't fool me.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: No matter what she says, I don't want to see her. Tell her that.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But what about Lava and Saga?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: They—

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: What... Where?!

a.text: And smelt an edge to slice the sky!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: W-What?! Where is this sound coming from?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Get down!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: *cough* *cough*—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: —What in the world did you come up with again?!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, it's just a big-ass firecracker. Eight feet long and three feet wide, uses the latest and greatest technology, never before seen in Terra, for its ignition!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You know how close I was? You could've at least warned me before you set that thing off!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: We didn't have the time. She would've gotten away again.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Isn't that right, my dear little sister?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: —You.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How dare you burn my art!

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Your art?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, I see. The moment we flung that door open, we'd already stepped into the world of your paintings, huh?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Or are we in the middle of a hike? Maybe this whole mountain is just a fantasy that you've dreamt up?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Oh, no wonder I could never find you, you unsociable loner—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: W-What?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's right. I mean, you can't possibly hide all that junk in a cottage that small, can you? Are you telling me none of you figured that out?

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hm, I guess most people's cognition and senses get affected, though. Can't blame you for not noticing, then.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: It's just like how you wouldn't feel anything's off no matter what kind of weird dream you have in your sleep.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Aha, you mad because I blew your little secret?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I'll beat you up and send you back to that mausoleum, 'Big Sis.'

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Eh, that place was destroyed long ago.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Oh, perfect, then. It's time to build a new one, and we'll give its design a little more thought this time.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hehe, you haven't changed at all. Always such a foulmouth when you're pissed... Did you just call me 'Big Sis' though?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: ...You heard that right. After all, when you have to kill someone, it costs nothing to be cordial.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Don't worry, my 'little sister.' How many times have you defeated me?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Don't be so confident, my all bark and no bite big sister.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Well, I wonder about that, my cocky little sister.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Kroos, Mr. Nothing, hide!

a.text: Heavenly forge, take the bounty of the earth and smelt an edge to slice the sky.
Starshrouded snow, hidden moon, let the crude mounts' waters sweep the streams.
